title: review-loop per-run state file
description: Lives at .claude/state/review-loop-${PR_NUM}.json. Single-run informational record. Archived on Step 16 exit. Inherits codex_processed_reviews from prior session.

codex_processed_reviews.description: Cross-iter / cross-run dedupe of surfaced Codex reviews. See references/codex-state-machine.md.

items.description: CodeRabbit review id whose outside-diff findings were judged.

cr_processed_reviews.description: Cross-iter / cross-run dedupe of CodeRabbit review-body (outside-diff) findings, inherited like codex_processed_reviews. See scripts/fetch-cr-outside-diff.sh.

cr_source.description: Resolved source after Step 5b heuristic and Step 7c silent flip. 'pending' before any iter has run.

followup_issue.description: The single issue Step 14 files for findings the run left behind. Present only once creation succeeded; its presence is what makes minor_floor / churn auto-merge eligible, and it makes the creation idempotent across re-runs.

auto_judge_log.description: One record per Step 9c decision (references/autonomous-judgment.md, "Log entry shape"). scripts/auto-merge-gate.sh reads the current iteration's apply records to pick next_action.

comment_id.description: The finding's databaseId (CR thread) or comment_id (Codex); Step 9a skips a thread this run already judged.

category.description: CR/CLI header category as read (e.g. "🔒 Security & Privacy"); empty for Codex.

badge_or_sev.description: CR/CLI severity as read (e.g. "🟡 Minor") or the Codex badge ("P1").

base_push.description: Set by Step 15 when the held Minor-or-lower fixes were pushed straight to the base after the merge (ADR 0006): {branch, sha, fixes}.
